_comment: Roots the songs indexer walks. Path '~' is expanded to $HOME at runtime. Update these paths to point at wherever your audio actually lives. The indexer skips any root that doesn't exist (logged, not an error).

_schema.roots[].label: Short slug used as the catalog 'label' field — also used in the Songs panel grouping.
_schema.roots[].path: Absolute path or '~/...' relative to $HOME. Recursively walked.
